Projects / Health Longevity Service

Pilot Project on Health Longevity Service

A health initiative for people over 60, women and other community members, with healthy and dignified ageing at its centre.

Location
Mathatirtha Health Post, Chandragiri Municipality–8
Date
Shrawan 30, 2083
Status
Completed

Services

  • Health check-up
  • Blood pressure
  • Blood sugar
  • Video X-ray
  • Geriatrics
  • Gynecology
  • Pulmonary Function Test
  • Respiratory consultation
  • Medicines & health materials

The program was held at Mathatirtha Health Post for people over 60, women and other community members, with a focus on healthy and dignified ageing.

Specialist services

  • Consultant Physician / Geriatrician
  • Consultant Gynecologist
  • Consultant Radiologist
  • Pulmonary Function Test and respiratory consultation with support from Cipla Nepal

Partners and support

Medicines and health materials were provided. Supporting companies included CIPLA-Nepal, Deurali Janta Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd., Magnus Pharma Pvt. Ltd., Intas Pharmaceuticals and Blue Cross Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.

Timely referral

One emergency patient was identified during the program and referred immediately to hospital for further treatment.

The objective was to promote long-term health, timely disease identification, proper treatment, health awareness and healthy, respected ageing.
